{{Quote|So I headed for the Taanab moon's ice ring and waited.|Lando Calrissian, ''[[Oral History of the New Republic]]''|<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
'''Taanab's moon'''<ref name="J5" /> was a pale<ref name="TEGtPaM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> [[Moon/Legends|moon]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]]<ref name="J5" /> located in the [[Taanab system/Legends|Taanab system]] of the [[the galaxy]]'s [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Battle of Taanab/Legends|Battle of Taanab]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] hid in the moon's ice ring.<ref name="J5" />
